title: Internal Phishing Campaign: Choosing Actions
context: Your organization launches a simulated phishing campaign, then must use the results to improve security awareness.

n1.text: Before sending, what must you plan as a priority?

choices.text: A clear objective, defined audience, and approval from management and legal
choices.why: A campaign is a governed action: without objective or authorization, it loses legitimacy.

choices.text: The trickiest possible message, without notifying anyone
choices.why: Realism does not excuse skipping scoping and authorization.

choices.text: Publishing the employee ranking before sending

n2.text: Results: 18% clicks and only 4% reports. Which type of training do you deploy first?

choices.text: Remedial training for those who clicked and targeted phishing training for exposed teams
choices.why: The trigger is a mistake (remedial) and the risk is tied to an audience (targeted).

choices.text: Initial onboarding training for the entire organization
choices.why: Onboarding is for new hires, not an observed behavior.

choices.text: No training: the drop in clicks is enough
choices.why: A low reporting rate shows active vigilance remains insufficient.

n3.text: One quarter later, clicks drop and reports rise. What do you report to management?

choices.text: Compared metrics and an executive report with trends and upcoming actions
choices.why: Metrics and executive reports are the official deliverables for effectiveness tracking.

choices.text: Only the number of messages sent
choices.why: Volume sent does not measure program effectiveness.

choices.text: The risk score of an external vendor
choices.why: That is a third-party risk indicator (5.3), unrelated to internal awareness.

n4.outcome: You scoped the campaign, chose remedial and targeted training, and delivered actionable metrics.

debrief: Every internal campaign requires an objective, an audience, and authorization.
The trigger determines the training type: mistake = remedial, role risk = targeted.
Metrics and executive reports measure effectiveness over time.
